# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser game called Capsule Sort Safari. It is a satirical creature-collecting liquid sort puzzle where a wild capsule requests an exact species and liquid aura. The player has three species buttons, three liquid color buttons, and one large SORT IT button. Correct exact matches grant Sort XP, refill the Vibe Timer, increase pressure slightly, emit rainbow particles, and advance to the next request. Wrong submissions drain the timer and show meme feedback. The session ends when the timer reaches zero.

Use a portrait-first pastel dream/rainbowcore/y2k art direction with procedural Canvas capsule creatures, liquid gradients, glassy HUD panels, animated sticker motifs, short readable copy, and one-thumb bottom controls. Preserve the timer, scoring, difficulty, exact-match, submit, start, game-over, and restart mechanics exactly.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source identity as implemented
The source game is a real-time request matching arcade game. A customer requests one of three outfit types and one of three colors. The player chooses type and color buttons, then presses a submit button. Correct submissions add 100 points, refill timer by 15, increase difficulty by 0.05, spawn particles, and move to the next request. Wrong submissions subtract 20 timer. The timer drains while the request is waiting; reaching zero ends the run.

## Protected mechanics
- Start screen, active play, game over, restart state flow.
- Three type choices and three color choices.
- Explicit send/sort button required to evaluate the current selection.
- Exact pair match required for success.
- Score +100 on success.
- Timer +15 capped at 100 on success.
- Difficulty multiplier increases by 0.05 on success.
- Timer -20 on wrong submit.
- Timer drains only while the request is waiting.

## Transformable surfaces
Presentation, copy, Canvas drawing functions, entity silhouettes, background, HUD language, button styling, particle styling, and optional SFX can change safely because they do not alter the protected matching loop.

## Rebuilt target
Capsule Sort Safari preserves the classification/order-matching mechanic while reframing it as a satirical creature-liquid sort puzzle. The player sorts by species and liquid aura in a rainbowcore pastel lab with mobile-first controls.
